invariants: A claim that the reader handles a form is backed by a fixture compiled by a real resource compiler, not by a hand-made byte string.
summary: tests/test_win_resources.rex makes 46 checks against tests/fixtures/app.rc, compiled by llvm-rc 18 into app.res and linked by lld-link into app.dll. llvm-readobj independently lists the same 7 resources, and .res and .dll give identical answers for every template. Upstream's corpus: the 26 official ooDialog sample .rc files (ooRexx GitHub c12e988) were compiled with llvm-rc. 24 compile; 2 fail on upstream defects (customDrawListView.rc includes a customDraw.h that does not exist; oodStandardDialogs.rc names oodStandardDialog.ico, but the file is oodStandardDialogs.ico). The reader decodes all 50 resources from the 24: 44 dialogs with 534 controls, and 3 menus. With --readobj, every resource's type, name, language and size matches llvm-cvtres plus llvm-readobj.
title: Tests: a built fixture, and upstream's own ooDialog samples
